subject: Re: Encord & Sportradar - Path Forward
text:
Hello Skander,

I am sending over more detailed list of items we would like to test and names of our testers as pre-read before our meeting,

Data curation testers explicitly asked for some kind of presentation / overview of data curation and data management capabilities, as that may help them define testing scenarios more properly and compare to our current capabilities and our plans for the future. It may be useful to do that before the official hands-on trial, to avoid eating avay the time dedicated for that and give us some time to better prepare testing scenarios.

Even-though we have two separate test-streams, it would be good to provide access to all features to both teams.

Data Annotation test
Sportradar testers:

  *   Pauline Nerriere (p.nerriere@sportradar.com<mailto:p.nerriere@sportradar.com>)
  *   Vasilii Solovev (v.solovyov.ext@sportradar.com<mailto:v.solovyov.ext@sportradar.com>)
  *   Both should have ability to act in different roles (annotator, QA, annotation team manager, admin)

Data:

  *   Sportradar will provide a couple of short video clips from few different sports (basketball, soccer, tennis)
  *   No need for NDA
  *   Will be shared today after our call.

We would like to test:

  1.  Data curation for the annotation project
  2.  Wide variety of annotation capabilities
     *   Regular annotation work (bbox, lines, points, etc.)
     *   Auto-annotation using SAM2 and Google Gemini
     *   Audio annotations
     *   Possibility of niche annotation work (flying ball projected on a floor, court homography)
  3.  Annotation monitoring features (statistics on annotation progress, quality of annotation work by specific annotator, time spent on task / annotation type to draw further predictions, etc.)
  4.  Annotation quality control (manual, automated using custom rules / tests, automated using custom models)
  5.  Annotation project creation, settings, annotation team and workflow management
  6.  Learn more about APIs and further options

To remind you of the goal, we are using multi-modal models to classify break dancing moves focusing on two specific questions:

  *   Can AI identify top level taxonomy moves (toprock, footwork, freezes) which vary greatly in form and execution?
  *   Can AI identify small nuances in execution across variations of windmills?

In the spreadsheet you will find the human labeled samples, links to the associated video files, and a tab with the written descriptions of the poses.

We are looking for software that can support us with:

  *   The video annotation process
  *   Vision fine tuning
  *   Testing video classification accuracy
  *   Latency of such classification
  *   Model evaluation

subject: Re: Encord Picing
text:
Hi Steffan,

Thanks for following up!

As discussed, we’re starting small for now—large-scale curation is
currently out of scope. Over the next six months, we’re focused on targeted
annotation projects and iterating on our existing dataset.

However, beyond that, we will consider extending our usage, and I believe
the ROI in starting large scale curation work on Encord will be much
clearer at that stage. Especially if we’re already integrated with your
platform and using it for our baseline data work.And looking beyond a
one-year horizon, we expect to scale significantly and raise our Series A.
At that point, both our usage and budget will expand considerably.

I appreciate your flexibility and understand that working within our budget
constraints might be a stretch. That said, one of the challenges we face is
that we’re currently paying $15K per year with V7, which makes it difficult
to justify a significant price hike, even if we recognize that Encord is a
stronger platform with better support. Additionally, we’re in discussions
with Dataloop, which we currently prefer over V7, and it looks like they
may be able to meet our needs at around $20K.

We’d love to explore options that align with our current phase while
keeping the door open for a long-term collaboration. Let me know what could
be possible.

Best,

Mate
